# google_parameter_manager_regional_template_version

A Regional Template Version resource stores the templated payload for a
Regional Template, using `{{.variableName}}` placeholders that are resolved
from a Regional Parameter Version's data at render time.


To get more information about RegionalTemplateVersion, see:

* [API documentation](https://cloud.google.com/secret-manager/parameter-manager/docs/reference/rest/v1/projects.locations.templates.versions)

~> **Warning:** All arguments including the following potentially sensitive
values will be stored in the raw state as plain text: `template_data`.
[Read more about sensitive data in state](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/manage-sensitive-data).

## Example Usage - Regional Template Version Basic


```hcl
resource "google_parameter_manager_regional_template" "regional-template-basic" {
  template_id = "regional_template"
  location    = "us-central1"
}

resource "google_parameter_manager_regional_template_version" "regional-template-version-basic" {
  template             = google_parameter_manager_regional_template.regional-template-basic.id
  template_version_id  = "regional_template_version"
  template_data        = "greeting: hello {{.name}}"
}
```

## Example Usage - Regional Template Version With Json Format


```hcl
resource "google_parameter_manager_regional_template" "regional-template-basic" {
  template_id = "regional_template"
  location    = "us-central1"
  format      = "TEMPLATE_FORMAT_JSON"
}

resource "google_parameter_manager_regional_template_version" "regional-template-version-with-json-format" {
  template             = google_parameter_manager_regional_template.regional-template-basic.id
  template_version_id  = "regional_template_version"
  template_data = jsonencode({
    "greeting" : "hello {{.name}}"
  })
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `template_data` -
  (Required)
  The template data. Use `{{.variableName}}` placeholders for values
  that are resolved from a Regional Parameter Version's data when the
  Regional Template Version is rendered.
  **Note**: This property is sensitive and will not be displayed in the plan.

* `template` -
  (Required)
  Parameter Manager Regional Template resource.

* `template_version_id` -
  (Required)
  Version ID of the Regional Template Version resource. This must be unique within the Regional Template.


* `disabled` -
  (Optional)
  The current state of the Regional Template Version. If true, the payload
  is never returned by read or render calls. This field is only applicable
  for updating a Regional Template Version.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `{{template}}/versions/{{template_version_id}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the Regional Template Version. Format:
  `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/templates/{{template_id}}/versions/{{template_version_id}}`

* `create_time` -
  The time at which the Regional Template Version was created.

* `update_time` -
  The time at which the Regional Template Version was updated.

* `location` -
  Location of the Parameter Manager Regional Template resource.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


RegionalTemplateVersion can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/templates/{{template_id}}/versions/{{template_version_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import RegionalTemplateVersion using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    template_version_id = "<-required value->"
    location = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_parameter_manager_regional_template_version.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import RegionalTemplateVersion using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/templates/{{template_id}}/versions/{{template_version_id}}"
  to = google_parameter_manager_regional_template_version.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), RegionalTemplateVersion can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_parameter_manager_regional_template_version.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{location}}/templates/{{template_id}}/versions/{{template_version_id}}
```
